scenario: [LNLS.3.10]'s exemptions: `len(s)` reads a stored byte count and `==` / `!=` compare interned strings, so neither needs `max_length`, and this rule compiles under `+nolinscan`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.bounded_string_op` names `upper` and `lower` only, and `lnls_compare` acts on ordering operators only.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Line scope logical:
    k: Int key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Line l where len(l.text) > 3 and l.text != "x"
->
    log info "x"
